description: List a YouTube channel's content by tab: videos (default), shorts, live streams, or community posts. The channel parameter accepts an @handle or channel URL. Sort applies to video-type tabs: latest (default), popular, or oldest. Returns cards with video ID, title, URL, duration, view count, and publish time; posts return text-based cards instead. Scrolls internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the tab's stream is exhausted. No authentication required.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Channel @handle (e.g. "@ExampleChannel") or channel URL (youtube.com/@handle, youtube.com/channel/UC...). Same as youtube/channel-info.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Channel tab to list. Full enum: videos 视频 (default, regular video list) | shorts Shorts 短视频 (vertical short videos) | live 直播 (live stream replays, publishedAt reads like "直播时间：4个月前") | posts 帖子 (community text/image posts). Not every channel has every tab; if the tab is missing the command fails and lists the tabs the channel actually has.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering for video-type tabs (videos/shorts/live; ignored for posts). Full enum: latest 最新 (default, newest first) | popular 热门 (most popular / most viewed) | oldest 最早 (oldest first).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-100, default 20). Scrolls internally; partial=true when the stream is exhausted.
